From Yellow Temperance · Price: integrated only; the slime eats anything that touches it, so allies avoid you.

Theme Affliction · Stand type integrated only

  • 1: 1 action: slime armor: resistance equal to half your level against physical damage; creatures that hit you in melee take 1 acid per die of your stand's Strike.
  • 5: Slime can take a disguise shape.
  • 9: Surge: slime engulfs a creature you grab: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[acid]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 13: Slime heals you for half the acid damage you deal.
  • 17: Resistance rises to your level.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.xp7q3A9lYiYbDwuU]{Effect: Slime Armor}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
